points_to_be_noted.double_quotes: all property key names and strings values must use double quotes (" "), not single quotes

datatypes.array: an ordered list of values enclosed in square brackets [] eg [1,2,3]
datatypes.object: A nested collection of key-value pairs enclosed in curly braces {}
datatypes.null: an empty or null value represented by null

points_to_be_noted.no_functions_or_undefined: JSON cannot store functions, undefined, or date objects
